Leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
Leaderboard.help: Top players or pairs by published Elo for the current sidebar filters.
Leaderboard.comment: @ in prompt means prompt is a key into ['SelectBoxes']['Vetted_Prompts']. {Rating_Type} is replaced from the Players/Pairs widget.

prompts.prompt: Top players by published Elo from session-level self.
prompts.sql:
WITH player_results AS (
  SELECT
    player1_id AS player_id,
    player1_name AS player_name,
    player1_scratch_elo_after AS scratch_elo,
    player1_handicap_elo_after AS handicap_elo,
    player1_{Elo_Kind}_elo_after AS elo_rating,
    COALESCE(National_Scratch_Pct, Club_Scratch_Pct) AS scratch_percentage,
    COALESCE(National_Handicap_Pct, Club_Handicap_Pct) AS handicap_percentage,
    iv_bonus,
    score_status,
    date
  FROM self
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    player2_id AS player_id,
    player2_name AS player_name,
    player2_scratch_elo_after AS scratch_elo,
    player2_handicap_elo_after AS handicap_elo,
    player2_{Elo_Kind}_elo_after AS elo_rating,
    COALESCE(National_Scratch_Pct, Club_Scratch_Pct) AS scratch_percentage,
    COALESCE(National_Handicap_Pct, Club_Handicap_Pct) AS handicap_percentage,
    iv_bonus,
    score_status,
    date
  FROM self
),
player_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ARG_MAX(player_name, date) AS player_name,
    ROUND(ARG_MAX(scratch_elo, date), 1) AS scratch_elo,
    ROUND(ARG_MAX(COALESCE(handicap_elo, scratch_elo), date), 1) AS handicap_elo,
    ROUND(ARG_MAX(elo_rating, date), 1) AS elo_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS games_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN score_status = 'provisional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS provisional_games,
    ROUND(AVG(scratch_percentage), 2) AS avg_scratch_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(handicap_percentage), 2) AS avg_handicap_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(iv_bonus), 1) AS avg_iv_bonus,
    ROUND(AVG({Pct_Col}), 2) AS avg_percentage,
    ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP({Pct_Col}), 2) AS stdev_percentage
  FROM player_results
  GROUP BY player_id
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM player_aggregates WHERE games_played >= {Min_Games}
),
anchors AS (
  SELECT MEDIAN(elo_rating) AS prior_anchor, MEDIAN(scratch_elo) AS scratch_anchor FROM filtered
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    a.prior_anchor AS _prior_anchor,
    CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(f.elo_rating, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) AS raw_elo_int,
    CASE
      WHEN {Prior_Sessions} <= 0 OR a.prior_anchor IS NULL
      THEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(f.elo_rating, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST((CAST(f.games_played AS DOUBLE) * CAST(f.elo_rating AS DOUBLE) + CAST({Prior_Sessions} AS DOUBLE) * CAST(a.prior_anchor AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(CAST(f.games_played AS DOUBLE) + CAST({Prior_Sessions} AS DOUBLE), 0), 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER)
    END AS published_elo_int,
    CASE
      WHEN {Prior_Sessions} <= 0 OR a.scratch_anchor IS NULL
      THEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(f.scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST((CAST(f.games_played AS DOUBLE) * CAST(f.scratch_elo AS DOUBLE) + CAST({Prior_Sessions} AS DOUBLE) * CAST(a.scratch_anchor AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(CAST(f.games_played AS DOUBLE) + CAST({Prior_Sessions} AS DOUBLE), 0), 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER)
    END AS published_scratch_int
  FROM filtered f CROSS JOIN anchors a
)
SELECT
  CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY published_elo_int DESC, games_played DESC, player_name ASC, player_id ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Rank,
  published_elo_int AS {Elo_Col_Name},
  raw_elo_int AS {Elo_Col_Name}_Raw,
  CASE
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 2600 THEN 'SGM'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 2500 THEN 'GM'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 2400 THEN 'IM'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 2300 THEN 'FM'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 2200 THEN 'CM'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 2000 THEN 'Expert'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 1800 THEN 'Advanced'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 1600 THEN 'Intermediate'
    WHEN published_scratch_int >= 1400 THEN 'Novice'
    ELSE 'Beginner'
  END AS {Title_Col_Name},
  player_id AS Player_ID,
  player_name AS Player_Name,
  ROUND(avg_scratch_pct, 1) AS Avg_Scratch,
  ROUND(avg_handicap_pct, 1) AS Avg_Handicap,
  ROUND(avg_iv_bonus, 1) AS Avg_IV_Bonus,
  ROUND(stdev_percentage, 1) AS Pct_Stdev,
  CAST(games_played AS INTEGER) AS Games,
  CAST(provisional_games AS INTEGER) AS Provisional_Games,
  _prior_anchor
FROM ranked
ORDER BY Rank ASC
LIMIT {Top_N}

prompts.prompt: Top pairs by published Elo from session-level self.
prompts.sql:
WITH pair_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pair_id,
    ARG_MAX(pair_name, date) AS pair_name,
    ARG_MAX(player1_id, date) AS player1_id,
    ARG_MAX(player2_id, date) AS player2_id,
    ARG_MAX(scratch_pair_elo, date) AS avg_scratch_elo,
    ARG_MAX(COALESCE(handicap_pair_elo, scratch_pair_elo), date) AS avg_handicap_elo,
    ARG_MAX({Pair_Elo_Col}, date) AS avg_pair_elo,
    AVG(COALESCE(National_Scratch_Pct, Club_Scratch_Pct)) AS avg_scratch_pct,
    AVG(COALESCE(National_Handicap_Pct, Club_Handicap_Pct)) AS avg_handicap_pct,
    AVG(iv_bonus) AS avg_iv_bonus,
    AVG({Pct_Expr}) AS avg_percentage,
    STDDEV_SAMP({Pct_Expr}) AS stdev_percentage,
    COUNT(*) AS games_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN score_status = 'provisional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS provisional_games
  FROM self
  GROUP BY pair_id
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM pair_stats WHERE games_played >= {Min_Games}
),
anchors AS (
  SELECT MEDIAN(avg_pair_elo) AS prior_anchor FROM filtered
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    a.prior_anchor AS _prior_anchor,
    CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(f.avg_pair_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) AS raw_pair_elo_int,
    CASE
      WHEN {Prior_Sessions} <= 0 OR a.prior_anchor IS NULL
      THEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(f.avg_pair_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST((CAST(f.games_played AS DOUBLE) * CAST(f.avg_pair_elo AS DOUBLE) + CAST({Prior_Sessions} AS DOUBLE) * CAST(a.prior_anchor AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(CAST(f.games_played AS DOUBLE) + CAST({Prior_Sessions} AS DOUBLE), 0), 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER)
    END AS published_pair_elo_int
  FROM filtered f CROSS JOIN anchors a
)
SELECT
  CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY published_pair_elo_int DESC, games_played DESC, pair_name ASC, pair_id ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Rank,
  published_pair_elo_int AS {Elo_Col_Name},
  raw_pair_elo_int AS {Elo_Col_Name}_Raw,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2600 THEN 'SGM'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2500 THEN 'GM'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2400 THEN 'IM'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2300 THEN 'FM'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2200 THEN 'CM'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 2000 THEN 'Expert'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 1800 THEN 'Advanced'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 1600 THEN 'Intermediate'
    WHEN CAST(ROUND(LEAST(GREATEST(avg_scratch_elo, 0), 3500), 0) AS INTEGER) >= 1400 THEN 'Novice'
    ELSE 'Beginner'
  END AS {Title_Col_Name},
  pair_id AS Pair_ID,
  pair_name AS Pair_Name,
  ROUND(avg_scratch_pct, 1) AS Avg_Scratch,
  ROUND(avg_handicap_pct, 1) AS Avg_Handicap,
  ROUND(avg_iv_bonus, 1) AS Avg_IV_Bonus,
  ROUND(stdev_percentage, 1) AS Pct_Stdev,
  CAST(games_played AS INTEGER) AS Games,
  CAST(provisional_games AS INTEGER) AS Provisional_Games,
  _prior_anchor
FROM ranked
ORDER BY Rank ASC
LIMIT {Top_N}
